component.name: Ferestre
component.summary: Run the Microsoft Store and Xbox GDK titles you own on Linux

description.p: ferestre downloads and launches Microsoft Store (MSIXVC) and Xbox GDK titles on Linux, using a patched Proton and a from-scratch implementation of the Xbox Game Development Kit runtime.

You must own the games. This application ships no game content, no licences and no content keys. It signs in with your own Microsoft account, uses your own licences, and downloads your own purchases. If your account does not own or have a Game Pass entitlement for a title, there is nothing here that will let you play it.
Known state of the supported titles:

ul.li: Minecraft for Windows (Bedrock): signs in, plays, and joins third-party servers
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33: playable, including saves and video
Forza Horizon 5: downloads but does not run, blocked by protection inside the title

description.p: The patched Proton runtime is roughly 264 MiB compressed, versions independently of this application, and is not part of this package.
Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Microsoft, Mojang, Valve or the Xodus project.
Use the compatibility display path for games without a tested native Wayland recipe, preventing automatic HDR detection from forcing an incompatible driver.
Keep Forza Horizon 6 native HDR explicitly enabled and preserve desktop display settings.
Keep My Library limited to owned and locally managed games instead of adding every compatibility recipe after sign-in.
Put screenshots and quick guides first in the README, with clearer installation, updates, controller and account instructions.
Enable native Wayland HDR on supported desktops, correct fractional scaling, and expose practical 4K and ultrawide game resolutions with the updated runtime.
Follow the desktop window-button layout automatically, confirm sign-out, and hold the available game performance profile during play.
Update installed games in their existing folder without an install-location prompt.
Fix Store library reload for delegationcompact tickets and explain service failures without internal temporary paths.
Resume running games, confirm Stop with a controller, select global and per-game runtimes, and resume updates directly.
Improved controller focus, a cleaner sidebar and Settings, reliable device-token recovery, and verified metadata reuse. Components build from pinned source forks.
